# CAMT.053 sample files

| File | Source | License |
|------|--------|---------|
| `genkgo/*.xml` | [genkgo/camt](https://github.com/genkgo/camt/tree/56e047d1599854ca34db0ccabce15230fcdd3f16/test/data) | MIT, see `genkgo/LICENSE` |
| `ideatic/complete.v8.xml` | Written for these tests: ultimate parties, batches, pending entries, structured references | MIT (this library) |
| `ideatic/bbva.v6.xml` | Written for these tests with fake data, with the same quirks as the BBVA export: IBAN in `Othr`, comma decimals with sign, `UNCATEGORIZED` indicator, `-` as empty value, opening and closing balances swapped | MIT (this library) |

The `genkgo` files are byte-for-byte copies.
